Profile.source: CapFrameX validation: Streamline was already loaded at attach and exposed no authoritative creation queue; bypass vendor presentation hooks and draw on native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues; control/status telemetry remains isolated from routing

CapFrameX validation: Streamline was already loaded at attach and its pass-through proxy exposed no authoritative creation queue; bypass vendor presentation hooks and draw on native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues; control/status telemetry remains isolated from routing

CapFrameX validation: inject when D3D12 is mapped; avoid the shared Release hook so the old flip-model swapchain can reach terminal destruction, use native DXGI Presents with observed DIRECT queues while frame generation is off, and make the API-provided FidelityFX proxy swapchain plus queue the exclusive render path while frame generation owns presentation

CapFrameX validation and RTSS 7.3.7 lifecycle model: bypass the shared DXGI Release hook so the old flip-model swapchain can reach terminal destruction, bypass all optional vendor presentation/lifecycle hooks, keep native DXGI Presents plus observed DIRECT command queues authoritative, permit only swapchain-independent Streamline control/status telemetry, and release completed overlay backbuffer references before DXGI creates a replacement swapchain during a live frame-generation transition

CapFrameX validation and RTSS 7.3.7 routing model: hook native DXGI Present plus observed DIRECT command queues only; do not hook Streamline, XeSS-FG or FidelityFX presentation paths; swapchain-independent Streamline control/status telemetry is allowed, and the temporary startup swapchain must be released without the shared DXGI Release hook
CapFrameX validation and RTSS NVPresent routing model: inject when D3D12 is mapped, bypass Streamline proxy rendering, and draw on eligible native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues

CapFrameX validation and RTSS routing model: inject after D3D12 is mapped, use native DXGI Present plus observed DIRECT command queues instead of vendor presentation hooks, keep control/status telemetry isolated, and disable the D3D11-only shared Release hook because Steam's DXGI interposer re-enters it
